metadata.title: Rodent Pharmacokinetics Study (single-dose IV vs PO, serial blood sampling)
metadata.purpose: Determine the plasma pharmacokinetic profile and oral bioavailability of a test compound in rodents after a single intravenous and a single oral dose, using serial blood sampling and LC-MS/MS bioanalysis.
metadata.scope: Small-molecule plasma PK in mouse (or rat) following one IV and one PO administration at matched dose. Covers randomization to route/time cohorts, dosing, serial blood collection, plasma preparation, bioanalysis, and non-compartmental PK/statistics. Out of scope: tissue distribution, metabolite ID, multi-dose/steady-state, and large-molecule PK.
metadata.estimatedTime: 1 dosing day (~6 h sampling window) + bioanalysis and PK modeling (2-3 days)
beforeYouBegin: OBTAIN AND RECORD IACUC (or equivalent ethics committee, e.g. BACUC) approval number BEFORE any animal work; this protocol must not be run without it.
Assign animals to route x time-point cohorts by a documented randomization method (e.g. random number list); record the scheme.
Blinding: bioanalyst and PK analyst should be blinded to group allocation where feasible; the source does not specify a blinding SOP (needsReview).
Compute the maximum permissible blood withdrawal per animal from body weight and circulating volume (see criticalNotes on the sampling steps and table t3) before drawing blood.
Prepare dosing formulations for both routes at the target concentration so the dose volume is within route limits.
Acclimate animals and confirm health status; decide fasting status for the PO arm and record it (fasting not specified by source; needsReview).

samples.name: Rodent cohort - IV route
samples.organism: Mouse (C57BL/6, BALB/c, CD1, or NMRI) or rat (Wistar or Sprague Dawley)
samples.description: Animals randomized to the IV arm; N=4 per time point (see table t1). Source strains: 'mouse inbred (C57BL/6, BALB/c), outbred (CD1, NMRI) strains, and Wistar, or Sprague Dawley rats'.

samples.name: Rodent cohort - PO route
samples.description: Animals randomized to the PO arm; N=4 per time point (see table t1).

samples.name: Whole blood samples (serial)
samples.description: Serial whole-blood draws at each scheduled time point into anticoagulant tubes.

samples.name: Plasma samples
samples.description: Plasma separated from each blood draw; analyte quantified by LC-MS/MS.

samples.name: Concentration-time dataset
samples.description: Per-time-point plasma concentrations used to derive NCA PK parameters (table t2).

tables.title: Study design: route x time-point cohorts (serial sampling)
tables.note: IV and PO time points and N=4/time point and 10 mg/kg from source src1; a typical mouse study uses ~50 animals total. t=0 predose baseline added per standard practice (not explicitly listed by src1; verify). Serial sampling = repeated draws from the same animal within an arm.

tables.title: Non-compartmental PK parameters to derive (per route)
rows: Area under concentration-time curve to last measurable point (linear/log-trapezoidal)
Absolute oral bioavailability = (AUC_PO x Dose_IV) / (AUC_IV x Dose_PO) x 100
tables.note: Derived/computed outputs. The schema has no computed-result construct; formulas are recorded here and referenced by the analysis steps. Specific NCA software not stated by source (needsReview).

tables.title: Maximum safe blood withdrawal reference (welfare constraint)
rows: ~10% of total blood volume per collection, no more often than every 2-4 weeks
~10% of total blood volume per collection, no more often than every 2-4 weeks
tables.note: From src2 (institutional blood-collection guidelines). Serial sampling must keep cumulative withdrawal within welfare limits; compute per-animal cap from body weight before drawing.

steps.action: Confirm IACUC/BACUC approval, randomize animals to route x time-point cohorts, weigh each animal, and record allocation.
steps.expectedResult: Documented, approved study design with per-animal weights and dose/blood-volume caps computed.
steps.criticalNotes: Do not proceed without a recorded ethics approval number. Compute each animal's maximum permissible blood withdrawal (~10% circulating volume; table t3) before dosing.
steps.safetyNotes: All in vivo work under approved animal-ethics protocol.

sourceReferences.excerpt: All study protocols are reviewed by Bienta's Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (BACUC)

steps.action: Prepare IV and PO dosing formulations of the test compound at concentrations giving 10 mg/kg within each route's volume limit.
steps.expectedResult: Two dose formulations ready and characterized.
steps.criticalNotes: Exact vehicles, dose volumes, and fasting status are not specified by the source and must be set and recorded per study.

steps.action: Administer a single IV bolus (10 mg/kg) to the IV cohort; record exact dosing time as t=0.
steps.expectedResult: IV cohort dosed; t=0 timestamp logged per animal.

steps.action: Administer a single PO gavage dose (10 mg/kg) to the PO cohort; record exact dosing time as t=0.
steps.expectedResult: PO cohort dosed; t=0 timestamp logged per animal.

steps.action: Collect serial whole-blood samples at each scheduled post-dose time point per arm, into anticoagulant tubes. IV: 5, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240 min. PO: 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 360 min. Include a t=0 predose baseline.

parameters.rawText: ~30 uL per serial draw (literature serial-sampling volume)

steps.expectedResult: A timed series of whole-blood samples per animal covering the full sampling window.
steps.criticalNotes: The schema has no time-series/loop construct: the full schedule lives in table t1 and is enumerated here as repeated time parameters. Keep cumulative serial withdrawal within the ~10% circulating-volume welfare cap (table t3). Per-draw volume (~30 uL) is from serial-sampling literature (src3), not from src1.
steps.safetyNotes: Use approved restraint/sampling sites; minimize distress.

sourceReferences.excerpt: 5, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240 min for IV and 15, 30, 60, 120, 240 and 360 min for PO ... 4 animals per each time point group/route

steps.action: Centrifuge blood to separate plasma; transfer plasma to labeled cryovials and store frozen until analysis.
steps.expectedResult: Plasma aliquots stored, ready for bioanalysis.
steps.criticalNotes: Centrifugation speed/time and storage temperature are lab SOP values, not stated by source.

steps.action: Quantify test compound in plasma by LC-MS/MS against a matrix-matched calibration curve with internal standard, using blank plasma for standards/QCs.
steps.expectedResult: Validated plasma concentration for every sample; concentration-time dataset assembled.
steps.criticalNotes: Internal standard, extraction solvent, and chromatographic method are method-specific (needsReview).

sourceReferences.excerpt: LC-MS/MS using AB Sciex API4000/3000 mass spectrometers and Shimadzu (Prominence, VP) HPLC systems

steps.action: Perform non-compartmental analysis (NCA) on the concentration-time data to derive Cmax, Tmax, AUC(0-t), AUC(0-inf), t1/2, CL, Vz/Vss, and absolute oral bioavailability F.

parameters.rawText: F(%) = (AUC_PO x Dose_IV) / (AUC_IV x Dose_PO) x 100

steps.expectedResult: Full NCA PK parameter set per route plus oral bioavailability, with summary statistics (mean +/- SD across N=4).
steps.criticalNotes: Derived/computed results have no native schema construct: parameter definitions and formulas are captured in table t2 and as 'other' free-text formula parameters here.

controls.name: Vehicle-control (blank) plasma
controls.description: Provides drug-free matrix for LC-MS/MS calibration standards and QC samples.

controls.name: Predose (t=0) baseline sample
controls.description: Confirms absence of analyte before dosing and provides per-animal baseline.

controls.name: IV reference arm
controls.description: IV data give 100% bioavailability reference for computing absolute F of the PO arm.

controls.name: Bioanalytical QC samples
controls.description: Low/mid/high QCs bracket runs to confirm assay accuracy/precision.

expectedOutputs: Plasma concentration-time profiles for the IV and PO arms (mean +/- SD, N=4 per time point).
Non-compartmental PK parameters per route: Cmax, Tmax, AUC(0-t), AUC(0-inf), t1/2, CL, Vz/Vss.
Documented ethics approval, randomization scheme, and per-animal dosing/blood-volume records.

troubleshooting.problem: Erratic terminal phase / poor lambda_z fit
troubleshooting.cause: Too few late time points or concentrations near LLOQ
troubleshooting.solution: Extend sampling window or improve assay sensitivity; report AUC(0-t) if extrapolation >20%
Gentle collection, prompt processing, verify spin conditions

troubleshooting.problem: Animal welfare limit reached during serial sampling
troubleshooting.cause: Cumulative blood withdrawal exceeds ~10% circulating volume
troubleshooting.solution: Reduce per-draw volume or switch to sparse/composite sampling design (table t3)

troubleshooting.cause: Dosing error, formulation instability, or first-pass metabolism
troubleshooting.solution: Verify dose/route records, formulation concentration, and assay recovery

safety: Conduct all animal procedures only under an approved IACUC/BACUC (or equivalent) protocol; record the approval number.
Respect species-specific circulating blood volume limits (~10% per collection) to avoid hypovolemia during serial sampling.
Handle test compound and organic extraction solvents (acetonitrile/methanol) per SDS in appropriate containment.
limitations: Plasma PK only; no tissue distribution, metabolite identification, or protein-binding correction. Vehicle, fasting status, exact per-draw blood volume, centrifugation, storage, internal standard, and NCA software are not specified by the primary source and are marked needsReview. t=0 predose point and ~30 uL draw volume are standard-practice/literature additions, not from the primary CRO source.
